name: toktickit
description: Full-suite test orchestration for TokTickIT (Lab 2, Issue #20). Not a workspace root — server/, client/, and e2e/ each remain independent npm packages with their own node_modules.

scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix e2e install && npm --prefix e2e exec playwright install chromium
scripts.test:all: npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run test:e2e
